back.name: Pull-ups
back.desc: Great for building width and upper body strength.

back.name: Deadlifts
back.desc: A powerhouse move for the entire posterior chain.

back.name: Lat Pulldowns
back.desc: Focuses on isolating the latissimus dorsi muscles.

back.name: Seated Cable Rows
back.desc: Improves mid-back thickness and posture control.

back.name: T-Bar Rows
back.desc: Builds overall back density and strength.

back.name: Face Pulls
back.desc: Strengthens rear delts and improves shoulder stability.

back.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Rows
back.desc: Enhances unilateral strength and corrects muscle imbalances.

back.name: Straight-Arm Pulldowns
back.desc: Isolates the lats and improves mind-muscle connection.

back.name: Inverted Rows
back.desc: Bodyweight movement for back thickness and endurance.

back.name: Rack Pulls
back.desc: Targets upper back and traps with heavier loads.

legs.name: Squats
legs.desc: The king of leg exercises for quads and glutes.

legs.name: Lunges
legs.desc: Excellent for balance and unilateral leg strength.

legs.name: Leg Press
legs.desc: Allows heavy loading while reducing lower back strain.

legs.name: Leg Curls
legs.desc: Directly targets the hamstrings for strength and definition.

legs.name: Standing Calf Raises
legs.desc: Builds calf size and ankle strength.

legs.name: Seated Calf Raises
legs.desc: Focuses on the soleus muscle for calf thickness.

legs.name: Step-Ups
legs.desc: Enhances explosive power and unilateral coordination.

legs.name: Hack Squats
legs.desc: Places more emphasis on quadriceps development.

arms.name: Hammer Curls
arms.desc: Targets the brachialis and forearm strength.

arms.name: Barbell Curls
arms.desc: The classic mass builder for the biceps peaks.

arms.name: Preacher Curls
arms.desc: Isolates the biceps and reduces momentum cheating.

arms.name: Concentration Curls
arms.desc: Enhances peak contraction and muscle focus.

arms.name: Incline Dumbbell Curls
arms.desc: Provides a deeper stretch for long head development.

arms.name: Cable Curls
arms.desc: Maintains constant tension throughout the movement.

arms.name: EZ Bar Curls
arms.desc: Reduces wrist strain while effectively targeting biceps.

chest.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
chest.desc: A free-weight upper-chest press performed on an incline bench that also strongly recruits the front delts and triceps while allowing a greater range of motion and independent arm movement for balanced chest development.

chest.name: Incline Bench Press
chest.desc: A barbell pressing exercise done on an incline bench that emphasizes the upper portion of the pectorals while also involving the shoulders and triceps for overall pressing strength and chest mass.

chest.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
chest.desc: A flat-bench chest press using dumbbells that targets the pectorals, front delts, and triceps while promoting a deeper stretch and more unilateral control than a barbell press.

chest.name: Bench Press
chest.desc: A foundational barbell compound lift where you press the weight from the chest to arm’s length, primarily building the pectorals, anterior deltoids, and triceps while improving upper-body strength.

chest.name: Smith Machine Press
chest.desc: A chest press performed on a fixed bar path that targets the chest, shoulders, and triceps while offering added stability and making it easier to focus on controlled hypertrophy work.

chest.name: Dips
chest.desc: A bodyweight pressing movement, often called a classic chest-and-triceps builder, where leaning forward increases chest involvement while still heavily training the triceps and front shoulders.

chest.name: Machine Chest Fly
chest.desc: An isolation exercise in which the arms move in an arcing motion to bring the handles together, directly training the pectoral muscles with constant tension and minimal triceps involvement.

chest.name: Push Ups
chest.desc: A bodyweight horizontal pressing exercise that works the chest, triceps, and shoulders while also requiring core stability, making it a versatile movement for strength and muscular endurance.

abs.name: Lying Floor Leg Raise
abs.desc: A lower-ab-focused bodyweight movement where you raise your legs from the floor under control, also challenging the hip flexors and core stability.

abs.name: Weighted Crunch
abs.desc: A resistance-based abdominal exercise where added weight increases tension on the rectus abdominis, helping build stronger and thicker abs.

abs.name: Leg Raises
abs.desc: A core exercise involving lifting the legs to target the lower portion of the abdominals while also engaging the hip flexors and improving trunk control.

abs.name: Cable Crunch
abs.desc: A kneeling or standing ab exercise using a cable stack to provide constant resistance while you flex the spine, strongly targeting the rectus abdominis.

abs.name: Plank
abs.desc: An isometric core exercise where you hold a straight-body position to train abdominal bracing, spinal stability, and endurance through the entire core.

abs.name: Abdominal Air Bike
abs.desc: A dynamic abs movement combining a bicycle-style leg motion with trunk rotation to work the rectus abdominis, obliques, and hip flexors.

abs.name: Rotating Mountain Climber
abs.desc: A fast-paced core and conditioning exercise where the knees drive across the body to engage the abs, obliques, shoulders, and cardiovascular system.

abs.name: Russian Twist
abs.desc: A rotational core exercise performed by twisting the torso side to side, primarily targeting the obliques while also involving the rectus abdominis and deeper stabilizers.

abs.name: Hands Overhead Ab Crunch
abs.desc: An abdominal crunch variation with the arms extended overhead to increase lever length and place greater demand on the upper abs during spinal flexion.

shoulders.name: Shoulder Press With Dumbbells
shoulders.desc: A dumbbell overhead press that primarily builds the front and side delts while also recruiting the triceps and upper chest, with each arm working independently for balanced shoulder development.

shoulders.name: Rear Delt Fly
shoulders.desc: An isolation movement where the arms move out and back to target the rear deltoids, while also engaging the upper back muscles that help support shoulder posture.

shoulders.name: Lateral Raises With Dumbbells
shoulders.desc: A classic shoulder isolation exercise in which the arms are raised out to the sides to emphasize the lateral deltoids and create wider-looking shoulders.

shoulders.name: Face Pulls
shoulders.desc: A cable-based pulling exercise that targets the rear delts, traps, and external rotators, widely used to improve shoulder health, posture, and upper-back balance.

shoulders.name: Shoulder External Rotation
shoulders.desc: A rotator cuff exercise focused on turning the arm outward against resistance to strengthen the external rotators and improve shoulder stability.

shoulders.name: Machine Reverse Fly
shoulders.desc: A machine isolation exercise that emphasizes the rear delts and upper back by guiding the arms outward and backward through a controlled path.

shoulders.name: Machine Shoulder Press
shoulders.desc: A guided overhead pressing movement that trains the delts and triceps with added stability, making it useful for focused shoulder hypertrophy.

shoulders.name: Cable Lateral Rises
shoulders.desc: A cable variation of the lateral raise that targets the side delts with more consistent tension throughout the full range of motion.
